tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// grub chen mi tra dzo kis mdzad pa'i snying po don gsum gyi man ngag gi rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang bzhugs so//

(606)༄༅// na mo gu ru we/ gdams pa 'di 'chad pa la don gsum ste/ dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ tshe 'dir rgyun gyi yi dam bsgom// 'chi khar 'pho ba'i gdams ngag bsgom// bar dor bsre ba bsgom bya ste// rgyun du bsgoms pa kun gyi gnad// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum ste/ tshe 'di'i nyams len gyi snying po rgyun gyi yi dam bsgom pa/ 'chi ka'i nyams len gyi snying po 'pho ba bsgoms pa/ bar do'i nyams len gyi snying po bsre ba bsgom pa'o// dang po la'ang bzhi las/ dang po rkyen bskul ma gdab pa'i man ngag ni/ mi rtag sdug bsngal dran byas nas// gnyis pa rgyu byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa ni/ snying rje chen po rab bskyed de// gsum pa bla ma yi dam la gsol ba 'debs pa'i man ngag ni/ spyi bor bla ma snying gar lha// bzhi pa ngo bo rang sems skye med du bsgom pa'i man ngag ni/ rang sems skye med bsgom par bya// gnyis pa la'ang bzhi las/ dang po sgyu lus tshogs su 'bul ba ni/ rang lus mchod sbyin byas nas ni// gnyis pa yid kyi 'brel thag bcad pa ni/ ltos pa thams cad rang spangs te// gsum pa thar pa'i lam chen dbye ba ni/ 'od kyi sbu gu'i sbyor ba yis// (607) bzhi pa rnam shes gong du 'pho ba ni/ sems ni dga' ldan gnas su 'phong*// gsum pa la'ang bzhi las/ dang po bar do ngo mi shes pa'i gnyen po yid la byed pa ni/ 'di nyid bar dor shes byas la// gnyis pa bar do tha mal du zhen pa'i gnyen po yid la bya ba ni/ phyi nang gsang ba bsgyur byas te// gsum pa chags sdang gis nying mtshams sbyor ba'i gnyen po yid la byed pa ni/ stong nyid snying rje'i rnal 'byor gyis// bzhi pa skye ba nges pa med pa'i gnyen po yid la bya ba ni/ mkhas pas nying mtshams sbyar ba ni// gsum pa lta sgom spyod gsum gyi man ngag gis mjug bsdu ba ni/ gang shar ngos 'dzin lta ba'i gnad// de la ma yengs sgom pa'i gnad// dran pa ro som spyod pa'i gnad// grub thob chen po'i gdams ngag go

/zhes gdams pa'i byung tshul dang bcas te ston pa yin no/ /'di'i sho lo ka dang po thub chen gyi gsung dngos yin la/ lhag ma rnams khro phu lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyis don 'grel gyi tshul du mdzad pa'o// shu bham/ ༈ snying po don gsum gyi brgyud 'debs byin rlabs mchog stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// thugs rje chen po blo gros rin chen dang*// (608)grub chen te lo pa dang la li ta// mi tra dzo ki khro phu lo tsā bar// gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnams gnyis stsol// bsod nams dbang phyug bsod nams seng ge dang*// rin chen seng ge kun mkhyen rin chen grub// byang chub rtse mo grags pa rgyal mtshan la// gsol ba= /phyogs las rnam rgyal 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i zhabs// zla ba rgyal mtshan mkhyen rab chos kyi rje// kun spangs chen po blo gsal rgya mtsho la// gsol ba= /mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug byams pa skal bzang dang*// dbang phyug rab brtan khyab bdag zhwa lu pa// 'jam dbyangs grags pa dge legs rgya mtsho la// gsol ba= /byams mgon bla ma kun mkhyen 'jig med dbang*// dkon mchog rgyal mtshan bstan pa rab rgyas zhabs// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis rtsol// zhes pa'am/ yang na rin chen grub kyi rjes/ gzhon nu bsod nams 'jam mgon yab sras la// gsol ba= /chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs pa chos 'byor dang*// dge 'dun rgya mtsho bsod nams grags pa'i sde// bsod nams rgya mtsho bsod nams dpal bzang la// gsol= chos dpal bzang po dpal 'byor lhun grub dang*// phrin las rab rgyas blo bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs// 'jam dbyangs grags pa man 'dra/ gang ltar yang mthar/ mi rtag sdug bsngal dran pa'i nges 'byung gis// skyabs su 'gro ba byang chub sems bskyed nas// zab gsal bla ma lha yi rnal 'byor dang*// sems nyid skye med gnas lugs mngon gyur shog

/zag bcas phung po'i mchod sbyin byas nas kyang*// gnyen 'khor longs spyod lus kyi zhen pa spangs// 'od zer lcags kyus rang sems spyan (609)ras gzigs// ma pham mgon po'i thugs kar 'pho bar shog /'dir snang rmi lam bar do rjes dran cing*// snod bcud rnam dag snang stong chen por shar// stong nyid snying rjes chags sdang rang grol nas// myur du zung 'jug go 'phang thob par shog / ces pa 'di'ang ris med pa'i bstan pa la mchog tu dad pa'i blo gros kyi ut+pal kha yongs su bye ba shākya'i dge slong gzhon nu mkhyen brtse'i ming can gyis gsol ba btab pa sid+dhi rastu/ ༈ 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid snying po don gsum gyi nyams len mdor bsdus pa grub pa mchog gi shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru lo ke shwa rā ya/ rgyal kun snying rje'i rang gzugs pad dkar 'chang*// ngur smrig gar gyis rnam rol chos kyi rje// dpal ldan bla'i zhabs la gus btud nas// gang de'i snying po'i rnal 'byor cung zad dbye// de la 'dir grub pa'i dbang phyug mi tra dzo ki nas brgyud pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dmar khrid snying po don gsum gyi gdams pa zab mo mdor bsdus te nyams su len pa'i tshul la gzhung rtsa ba las/ tshe 'dir rgyun gyi yi dam bsgom// 'chi kar 'pho ba'i gdams ngag bsgom// bar dor bsre ba bsgom bya ste// rgyun du bsgom pa kun gyi gnad// ces gsungs pa ltar/ tshe 'di'i nyams len gyi snying po rgyun gyi yi dam bsgom pa/ 'chi ka'i nyams len gyi snying po 'pho ba bsgom pa/ bar do'i nyams len gyi snying po bsre ba bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ mi rtag sdug bsngal dran byas nas// snying rje chen po rab bskyed de// spyi bor bla ma snying gar lha// rang sems skye med bsgom par bya// zhes pa'i don nyams su len pa la/

bde ba'i stan la bsam (610)gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'dug ste/ rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi rten khyad par can 'di lta bu thob kyang do nub tsam yang mi 'chi ba'i gding med/ shi ba'i 'og tu dkar nag gi las 'ba' zhig gi rjes su 'brang nas khams gsum gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin kho na las ma 'das pas/ da res thar pa'i lam sne zin pa zhig ci nas kyang bya'o snyam du nges 'byung shugs drag po bskyed bzhin pa'i ngang*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dpag bsam gyi sdong pos btegs pa'i pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i g.yas su bla ma/ mdun du sangs rgyas/ g.yas su chos/ g.yon du dge 'dun/ rgyab tu dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur dmigs te 'dun pa rtse gcig pas/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod sogs sam// bdag sogs 'gro kun byang chub snying po'i bar// bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// gzhan phyir sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i blos// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang bsgom par bgyi// lan gsum// rang gi spyi bor shel dkar las grub pa'i// byang chub mchod rten mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs pa// bang rim bzhi la sgo stong ldan pa'i dbus// pad zla'i steng du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor// bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong ni sgo stong la// rigs bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par bzhugs// snying khar pad+ma 'dab stong lte ba ru// rang sems 'phags mchog kha sar pa ṇi dang*// 'dab ma stong la a yig dkar po stong*// mu tig phreng ba lta bur gsal ba yi// lha rnams gnas (611)gsum yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan// 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med gyur// brgyud 'debs rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i dngos// bla ma spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ci nus mthar// zhes pas gsol ba btab spyi bo'i bla ma yi// sku las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun babs te// lus kyi nang gang nad gdon sdig sgrib dag

/byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad thob par gyur// de yi ngang las skad cig dran rdzogs su// pad dkar zla steng rang nyid spyan ras gzigs// sku mdog dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa// dang po'i phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar// g.yas g.yon 'og mas shel phreng bad dkar bsnams// yid 'phrog dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// snang stong zung 'jug chen por gsal ba yi// thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs dbus su// zla steng hrīḥmathar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor// de las 'od 'phros rigs drug khams kun khyab// so so'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas yongs sbyangs nas// phyi snod rnam dag ri bo gru 'dzin zhing*// nang bcud 'gro kun thugs rje chen po'i sku// sgrar grags yi ge drug ma'i sngags kyi sgra// dran rtog 'od gsal chos skur ro gcig gyur// ces brjod cing bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ḥ zhes ci nus bzla/ spyi bo'i bla ma snying ga'i yi dam dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams a yig stong la thim// mchod rten nam (612)mkha' 'ja' tshon bzhin du yal// snod bcud 'od zhu rang thim rang nyid kyang*// rim gyis 'od zhu stong pa nyid du gyur// zhes pa'i rjes su rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par zhi lhag gzung 'jug spros bral stong pa nyid kyi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag /thun de las ldang bar brtsam pa na/ slar yang rang skad cig gis thugs rje chen po'i skur gsal/ snang srid snod bcud thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes pas/ de ltar rtogs pa'i 'gro ba kun la snying rje chen po'i blos/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yis myur du bdag /thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang 'grub gyur nas// mkha' khyab 'gro kun gcig kyang ma lus pa// thams cad de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces bsngo smon bya/ thun mtshams thams cad du'ang snang grags rig gsum 'phags pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi rnam rol du lta ba dang ma bral ba la bslab par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/

rang lus mchod sbyin byas nas ni// ltos pa thams cad rab spangs te// 'od kyi sbu gu'i sbyor ba yis// sems ni dga' ldan gnas su 'phang*// zhes pa'i don nyams su len pa la/ mdun mkhar tshogs zhing bla ma'i rnal 'byor ltar gsal btab/ rang sems thugs rje chen po'i rnam pa de nyid rgyang kyis 'thon/ spyi bo'i bla ma thugs rje chen po'i mdun du 'khod nas bdag gi phung po 'di la brten nas tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phung po rnying pa la phog pas tsho zhing che la snum bag dang ldan par gyur/ mgo bo gcig shul gcig skyes kyi tshul gyis lan gsum du tshang pas thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum du gyur pa'i khar/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo gri gug thogs pa zhi la chad/ phung po'i thod pa smin 'tshams nas bregs te bzhag pa'i nang du lus dum bur gtub/ bla ma'i zhal nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan gsum gsungs pas ma dag pa thams cad sbyangs shing*/ dag pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi nam mkha' dang mnyam par spel/ slar yang phyag g.yas thod pa thogs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros te bdud rtsi'i rgyun la bcus nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' (613)'gro chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa thams cad la mchod/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis byang*/ bdud rtsi'i lhag ma rigs drug gi mgron rnams la byin pas gang la gang 'dod pa'i yo byad du gyur nas longs spyod pas lus sems zag med kyi bde bas tshim par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ci mang brjod cing dmigs rnam nan tan du gsal btab nas mthar mi dmigs pa'i ngang du bzhag /de nas dgra gnyen la nges pa med pa dang nor rdzas dang lus la snying po med par shes pas de dang de'i 'brel thags rbad kyis bcad/ ri rab kyi steng gi sum cu rtsa gsum gyi nam mkhar dga' ldan gyi zhing khams bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su rgyal ba byams pa mgon po zhal rang re dzam bu'i gling la phyogs pa dang*/

rang lus stong sang nge ba'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma'i mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi'i tshang tsam du kha zum pa/ yar sna tshangs bug har re yod pa/ snying kha'i thad du rlung sems dbyer med kyi ngo bo yi dam spyan ras gzigs dang bcas pa rnams gsal btab la/ skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid// bla ma byams pa mgon por gsol ba 'debs// bdag 'dzin 'khri ba rtsad nas chod pa dang*// rnam shes dga' ldan 'pho bar byin gyi rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab pas rgyal ba byams pa'i thugs ka nas 'od kyi sbu gu ser po zhig byung nas rang gi spyi bor zug pa dang mnyam du/ de'i nang nas 'od kyi lcags kyu zhig nar gyis byung nas dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ snying ga'i rang sems thugs rje chen po'i ral pa la btab pas/ 'od de la lam gyi 'du shes/ rang nyid lam der 'gro ba'i 'du shes/ rje btsun gyi thugs kar 'pho ba'i (614)'du shes te/ 'du shes gsum ldan gyi ngang nas gsol ba drag tu btab pas hril gyis drangs te thugs kar reg pa'i mod rgyal ba'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres song snyam pa dran tsam gyi ngang*/ slar rang gnas su 'khod par mos/ de ltar yang yang sbyang zhing thun bsdu ba na/ 'od kyi sbu gu rbad kyis chad de rang gi tshangs bug ser 'khyil le bkag par bsam/ nam zhig las la sbyar ba'i tshe/ mar 'bebs pa'i dmigs pa mi byed par rgyal ba byams pa'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres pa de ka'i dang du mnyam par bzhag go /gsum pa ni/ 'di nyid bar dor shes byas la// phyi nang gsang ba bsgyur byas te// stong nyid snying rje'i rnal 'byor gyis// mkhas pas nying mtshams sbyar bar bya// zhes pa'i don nyams su len pa la/ thog mar nyin par gyi snang ba thams cad rmi lam yin snyam du bsam/ de 'byongs nas rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo shes pa byung ba dang*/ nyin snang thams cad bar dor dran pa'i 'dun pa drag ru bya/

de la goms pa na/ phyi snod thams cad dag pa'i zhing khams dang*/ nang bcud thams cad thugs rje chen po'i sku dang*/ de dag kyang snang la rang bzhin ma grub par chu zla'am 'ja' tshon lta bur gnas bsgyur nas/ tha mal gyi snang zhen btsan thabs su spang*/ khyad par bar do'i skabs su pha ma la chags sdang gi rtog pas skye gnas bzang por skyes pa'i gegs byed pas na chags pa'i gnyen por skye 'gags gnas gsum gyi rtsa gdar bcad de bde stong gi rgyas 'debs dang*/ sdang ba'i gnyen por 'gro kun pha mar rjes su dran pa'i snying rje chen po'i blos blangs te bsam bzhin du (615)srid pa nyid nye bar bzung ba dang*/ skye zhing skye ba thams cad du dal 'byor gyi rten khyad par can thob cing*/ lam 'di ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pas rjes su bzung nas tshul bzhin du nyams su blangs pa la brten nas tshe gcig gis zung 'jug gi go 'phang thob pa zhig ci nas kyang bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang*/ de ltar byed nus par gyur cig snyam pa'i smon lam dang*/ de ltar byed nus par bla ma dang dkon mchog mkhyen snyam pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa gsum la chig bsgril du 'bad par bya ba dang*/ mdor na/ gang shar ngos 'dzin lta ba'i gnad// de la ma yengs sgom pa'i gnad// dran pa ro snyoms spyod pa'i gnad// grub thob chen po'i gdams ngag go /zhes gsungs pa'i don dus dang rnam pa kun tu gang shar gyi rtog pa ngos bzung ste bden med nam mkha' lta bur shes par bya ba ni lta ba'i gnad/ de'i ngang du bying rgod sogs kyi skyon spangs la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa ni sgom pa'i gnad/ rjes thob tu'ang snang ba thams cad rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bur dran pas bde sdug ro snyoms pa ni spyod pa'i gnad de/ tshul de lta bu'i nyams len gyis sgrub pa snying por bya ba ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mi yi gzugs su snang ba ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar nyi shus mdzes pa'i grub thob chen po mi tra dzo ki'i gdams ngag zab mo sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam tshang la ma nor ba yin pas dal ba'i rten la snying po ci nus su blangs bar bya'o// smras pa/

de ltar 'phags bod grub pa mchog rnams kyi// lam bzang gcig tu gyur ba'i shing rta 'dir// mtha' klas yid can brtse dga' rol pa'i (616)mod// byang chub snying po'i grong du gshegs gyur cig /ces pa'ang rang slob spang ba bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i dge slong 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin sogs don gnyer can rnams la lam 'di'i khrid smin par bgyis skabs skal bzang mkhyen brtse'i ming can gyis dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi bla brang thar pa rtser spar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo'i go 'phang la myur du reg pa'i rgyur gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༈

thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid mi tra lugs kyi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ngag 'don snying po bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhi/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dngos rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug grub chen mi tra dzo ki'i thugs bcud/ mkhas pa dang grub ba'i skyes bu bar ma chad pa las 'ongs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid snying po don gsum du grags pa las/ tshe 'di'i nyams len gyi snying po rgyun gyi yi dam bsgom pa'i tshul mdor bsdus pa ni/ skyabs yul gsal btab la/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// lan ji ltar rigs pas skyabs su 'gro/ shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pa'i// brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro bas bla ma dang lha'i rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya ste/ rang gi spyi bor shel dkar las grub pa'i// byang chub mchod rten mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs pa// bang rim bzhi la sgo stong ldan pa'i dbus// pad zla'i steng du bla ma spyan ras gzigs// skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor// bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong ni (617)sgo stong la// rigs bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par bzhugs// snying gar pad+ma 'dab stong lte ba ru// rang sems 'phags mchog kha sar pa ṇi dang*/ 'dab ma stong la a yig dkar po stong*// mu tig phreng ba lta bur gsal ba yi// lha rnams gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan// 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med gyur// brgyud 'debs rgyas pa'am bsdu na / dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i dngos// bla ma spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol//

ci nus mthar/ zhes pas gsol btab spyi bo'i bla ma yi// sku las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun babs te// lus kyi nang gang nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad thob par gyur// de'i ngang las skad cig dran rdzogs su// pad dkar zla steng rang nyid spyan ras gzigs// sku mdog dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa// dang po'i phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar// g.yas g.yon 'og mas shel phreng pad dkar bsnams// yid 'phrog dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// snang stong zung 'jug chen por gsal ba yi// thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs dbus su// zla steng hrīḥmathar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor// de las 'od 'phros rigs drug khams kun khyab// so so'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas yongs sbyangs nas// phyi snod rnam dag ri bo gru 'dzin zhing*// nang bcud 'gro kun thugs rje chen po'i (618)sku// sgrar grags yi ge drug ma'i sngags kyi sgra// dran rtog 'od gsal chos skur ro gcig gyur// ces brjod cing bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ spyi bo'i bla ma snying ga'i yi dam dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams a yig stong la thim// mchod rten nam mkha' 'ja' tshon bzhin du yal// snod bcud 'od zhu rang thim rang nyid kyang*// rim gyis 'od zhu stong pa nyid du gyur// zhes pa'i rjes su rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par zhi lhag zung 'jug spros bral stong nyid kyi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag /thun de las ldang bar brtsam pa na/ slar yang rang skad cig gis thugs rje chen po'i skur gsal/ snang srid snod bcud thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes pas/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba kun la snying rje chen po'i blos/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /thugs rje chen po 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog

/ ces sogs bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug pa'i gnas skabs thams cad du'ang snang grags rtog gsum 'phags pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi lam gyi lam khyer dang ma bral ba la bslab/ 'pho ba dang bsre ba'i rnal 'byor bsgom par 'dod na khrid yig las shes par bya'o// zhes pa'ang bya bral ma ṇi pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos shin tu blo dman nams la phan pa'i bsam pas ngag 'don snying por dril te sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig// /sarba maṅga laṃ/
